title: A different Saturday
text: It is a fun and rewarding experience. The teacher was well-informed and captured our attention with great charm. We learned a lot about vermouth from its origins, and the tasting was interesting. Later, we made our own vermouth and took it home. You can't ask for more!!!
author: Fearless26228035065

title: Chin chin
text: This class was a lot of fun. Elena was interesting and informative. We learned a lot about vermouth, got to try several drinks, and had a lot of fun crafting our own vermouths. The class size was perfect, and as usual at these type of experiences, but the end of the class (after everyone got to try some drinks), we were all chatting and laughing like old friends.
author: C9190AXjacobm

title: Do it!
text: Such a fun and informative experience! We learned the history behind vermut, how it’s made, and then got to create our own little bottle. I highly recommend!
author: 877judith

title: Learned a ton and had fun
text: I went to the Vermouth experience with my husband, and we had a great time. Elena, the host, was very charming and knowledgeable. She told us so many interesting things about vermouth; it changed my perception of this drink and enriched my horizon. The vermouth was delicious, and I was surprised by how versatile it is! Crafting our own beverage was fun and inspiring. I highly recommend this experience.
author: Olga_S

title: Learned a lot about vermouth
text: We found the activity enjoyable as well as educational.  It was a fun activity that we did as a family. The souvenir bottle of vermouth was a good idea as we had something to discuss even well after the activity.
author: AnnaMichele_R
